chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Jerome Pasquall as a top sax player; Cassino Simpson lost his mind
summary: Danny says the Black press made stars of musicians like Pasquall, and Cassino Simpson was a brilliant pianist ahead of his time.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: We were talking about Jerome Pasquall and these guys.

Well, Jerome Pasquall was considered one of the top saxophone players. Because the Pittsburgh Courier and the Chicago Defender would show you pictures of these guys, and you'd see who was great, and had a name. They wasn't loaded with musicians. You had outstanding musicians
Boy, he was really... He was in this band with Jabbo Smith, that they tried to come in after Louis Armstrong left, to make a tour in Chicago, and Cassino Simpson took over the band.
That's the boy that lost his mind.
Yeah. What a fantastic musician he was.
